title: ISO Capstone Exam Master AI Generator Specification
description: Comprehensive specification, schema template, and AI generation prompt for generating robust 60-question Capstone Exam datasets matching the ISO 45001 Internal Auditor architecture.

ai_instructions.role: You are a Senior ISO Lead Auditor and Educational Assessment Architect.
ai_instructions.task: Generate a full 60-question Capstone Exam dataset in valid JSON (or ES Module export default format) according to this exact specification.
dataset_requirements: Total pool size must be exactly 60 questions ('pool_size': 60).
Layout size presented per sitting is 35 questions ('layout_size': 35).
Case study category MUST contain 'Case Study' in its key string and contain 15 questions in the pool. The engine hardcodes 8 of these 15 questions into every exam sitting.
The remaining 45 pool questions are distributed across the standard domain blueprint categories.
Exhibits MUST include an 8-paragraph realistic audit narrative ('audit_story') and a 3-band 'finding_severity_matrix'.
Interactive tools MUST be included within the Case Study section using tool_types: 'context_sorter', 'flowchart_arranger', 'ncr_generator', and 'root_cause_tree'.
Options for multiple choice MUST be an array of objects: [{'text': '...', 'correct': true/false}].

exam_template_structure.title: ISO [STANDARD_NUMBER]:[YEAR] Internal Auditor — Capstone Exam
exam_template_structure.instrument_notice: This is a knowledge-underpinning assessment measuring recognition of correct audit reasoning, not the generative skills of live audit practice.
exam_template_structure.extraction_note: This 60-question pool feeds a stratified, category-aware extractor presenting 35 questions per sitting.

paragraphs: Paragraph 1: Context, external audit timeframe, recent site changes, regulatory shift...
Paragraph 2: Initial documentation review (HIRA / Aspect Register / Quality Plan)...
Paragraph 3: Fieldwork interview with operator/technician revealing procedural gap...
Paragraph 4: Cross-referencing two independent records revealing discrepancy...
Paragraph 5: Synthesis of finding (uncontrolled change + untrained personnel)...
Paragraph 6: Five-Whys root cause trace through organizational handoffs...
Paragraph 7: Auditee proposed immediate containment vs systemic investigation...
Paragraph 8: Audit reporting, severity classification, and Management Review prep.

finding_severity_matrix.description: Severity model: Score = Potential Harm x Likelihood of Recurrence.

single_select.lms_direction: Review LMS Activity X.Y — Clause Z.

interactive_tool_context_sorter.text: Sort the following context factors into their respective categories under Clause 4.1.

interactive_tool_flowchart_arranger.text: Arrange the audit steps in chronological order as performed by the auditor.

interactive_tool_ncr_generator.text: Complete the Nonconformity Report for the observed finding.
interactive_tool_ncr_generator.rationale: Audit classification and clause selection justification.

interactive_tool_root_cause_tree.text: Trace the observed audit failure to its systemic root cause using Five Whys.

levels.question: Why did the immediate operational failure occur?
Why did the procedural trigger fail?
Why was the systemic handoff missing?
